title: Marketing
description: Building a business is not an easy task, and Marketing is one of its pillars. Knowing your customer leads to the right audience targeting and drives results. Learn strategies, pricing, and advertising.

title: Human Resource Management
description: Learn how to hire the right talent, manage employees effectively, understand workplace behavior, and build a people-first work culture that drives growth and harmony.

title: Finance
description: Handling others' money is not a joke. That's why investment & portfolio management, tax planning, and credit risk analysis are required. Pursue an BBA in Finance and be the master of it.

title: Operations
description: Master the art of process optimization, supply chain management, and quality control to ensure business operations run smoothly, efficiently, and cost-effectively.

title: Information Technology
description: Learn the latest technologies, IT fundamentals, databases, software tools, and create an impact on the businesses around you. Develop machines and build new things with DIMTECH’s practical exposure.

title: Cooperative Management
description: Learn the art of managing societies through democratic systems and laws. Gain knowledge about the principles and practices of co-operation, co-operative legislation, and credit co-operatives. Master etiquette, working style, developing rules and regulations, and think about members/employees for financial help.
